stories.title: Relatório da Polícia Civil de SP vê 'consistentes suspeitas' de desvio de recursos de contrato de wi-fi para Dark Horse

en.title: São Paulo Civil Police report finds 'consistent suspicions' of resource diversion from wi-fi contract to Dark Horse
en.summary: A São Paulo Civil Police report identified suspicions that public funds from the 'WiFi Livre SP' program were diverted to finance the Dark Horse film, a biography of former president Jair Bolsonaro. The report was released by Supreme Court Justice Flávio Dino.

stories.title: Em resposta a Fachin, PF diz ter condições de enviar dados do celular de Vorcaro ao STF

en.title: In response to Fachin, PF says it has conditions to send Vorcaro's cellphone data to STF
en.summary: The Federal Police responded to Justice Fachin stating they are capable of transmitting cellphone data from Vorcaro to the Supreme Court.

stories.title: Dino determina fim do sigilo de investigações sobre o filme Dark Horse

en.title: Dino orders end of secrecy on Dark Horse film investigation
en.summary: Supreme Court Justice Flávio Dino lifted the confidentiality status of materials seized by São Paulo police investigating the diversion of parliamentary amendments to finance the Dark Horse film. He ordered the material to be forwarded to federal authorities.

stories.title: Loteria Federal 6100-0: bilhete principal de R$ 500 mil não tem comprador

en.title: Federal Lottery 6100-0: main ticket of R$ 500,000 has no buyer
en.summary: The main prize ticket worth 500,000 reais from Federal Lottery draw 6100 held on Sunday was not claimed by any winner.

stories.title: Loteria Federal hoje: resultado do concurso 6100 e números sorteados

en.title: Federal Lottery today: results of draw 6100 and numbers drawn
en.summary: The Federal Lottery draw 6100 took place on Sunday with five winning tickets announced, with the top prize of 500,000 reais going to ticket 070028. The next draw is scheduled for Wednesday.

stories.title: Dino tira sigilo de investigação da polícia de São Paulo sobre produtora de 'Dark Horse'

en.title: Dino lifts secrecy of São Paulo police investigation into 'Dark Horse' producer
en.summary: Federal Supreme Court Justice Flávio Dino lifted confidentiality restrictions on São Paulo's Civil Police investigation into financing of the film "Dark Horse", which concerns former president Jair Bolsonaro's life.

stories.title: Dino retira sigilo de investigação sobre Dark Horse enviada pela Justiça de SP

en.title: Dino removes secrecy from Dark Horse investigation sent by SP Justice
en.summary: Federal Supreme Court Justice Flávio Dino removed confidentiality from an investigation related to the "Dark Horse" film.

stories.title: Fachin dá 24 horas para PF enviar informações sobre celular de Vorcaro

en.title: Fachin gives Federal Police 24 hours to send information about Vorcaro's cellphone
en.summary: Supreme Court President Fachin set a 24-hour deadline for Federal Police to provide information about the custody and condition of data extracted from former banker Daniel Vorcaro's mobile device.

stories.title: Dino tira sigilo de investigação sobre desvio de emendas parlamentares para Dark Horse

en.title: Dino lifts secrecy of investigation into diversion of parliamentary amendments for Dark Horse
en.summary: Federal Supreme Court Justice Flávio Dino removed confidentiality from investigations examining whether parliamentary amendments were diverted to finance the film "Dark Horse", which focuses on former president Jair Bolsonaro.

stories.title: Polícia de SP pede dados de Coaf de empresária de 'Dark Horse' desde maio

en.title: São Paulo Police requests Coaf data on 'Dark Horse' businesswoman since May
en.summary: São Paulo's Civil Police has been requesting court access since May to Coaf financial data on businesswoman Karina Gama, head of Instituto Conhecer Brasil, who signed million-dollar contracts with São Paulo's city government and the Go Up production company.

stories.title: Mega-Sena 3057 acumula e prêmio sobe para R$ 95 milhões

en.title: Mega-Sena 3057 accumulates and prize rises to R$ 95 million
en.summary: The Mega-Sena lottery draw 3,057 held in São Paulo had no winners in the main prize category, causing the jackpot to accumulate to R$ 95 million.

stories.title: PF diz a Fachin que pode encaminhar cópia de dados tirado de celular de Vorcaro a ministros

en.title: PF tells Fachin it can send copy of data extracted from Vorcaro's phone to ministers
en.summary: The Federal Police informed Minister Fachin that it has the technical capacity to produce and send Supreme Court ministers copies of data extracted from banker Daniel Vorcaro's phone, who is imprisoned following the extrajudicial liquidation of Banco Master.

stories.title: Trump diz não estar preocupado com possível cancelamento de visita por Xi

en.title: Trump says unconcerned about possible visit cancellation by Xi
en.summary: President Donald Trump stated he is not worried about the possibility that Chinese President Xi Jinping might cancel a visit scheduled for late this month.

stories.title: Trump diz a Zelensky, da Ucrânia, para parar de atacar diesel russo

en.title: Trump tells Zelensky of Ukraine to stop attacking Russian diesel
en.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump requested that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky halt attacks on Russian diesel infrastructure, claiming the strikes are causing fuel shortages affecting global markets. Ukrainian drone attacks on Russian oil refineries have reduced fuel production and created gasoline scarcity across Russia.

stories.title: Sem citar Moraes, PF questiona quem é ‘Andrei’ e ‘Paulo’ em mensagem enviada por Vorcaro ao ministro

en.title: Without citing Moraes, Federal Police question who are 'Andrei' and 'Paulo' in message sent by Vorcaro to minister
en.summary: Brazil's Federal Police inquired about the identities of 'Andrei' and 'Paulo' referenced in a message from banker Daniel Vorcaro to a Supreme Court minister's phone. The names refer to the Federal Police director-general and the attorney general, with Vorcaro expressing willingness to provide details through plea negotiations.

stories.title: Em resposta a Fachin, Polícia Federal diz que pode fornecer cópia de material do celular de Vorcaro

en.title: In response to Fachin, Federal Police says it can provide copy of material from Vorcaro's cellphone
en.summary: Brazil's Federal Police stated it can supply an identical copy of data extracted from former banker Daniel Vorcaro's seized cellphone to Supreme Court justices. The original material remains in police custody with documented integrity seals and digital verification mechanisms.

stories.title: Agenda do STF: Ministros pautam correção de plano de saúde de idoso e licença-maternidade

en.title: Supreme Court agenda: Ministers schedule health plan correction for elderly and maternity leave
en.summary: Brazil's Supreme Court scheduled judgments for Wednesday and Thursday following a week of cancelled sessions amid internal crisis. A Tuesday session analyzing the Master bank case, which sparked conflict within the Court, is receiving significant attention.
